decisions.rationale: The approved beans query already has twelve distinct results. Further primary choices need a reviewed grouping/navigation design and exact canned/dried identities before expansion; do not hide them through truncation.
decisions.revisit: Before adding more primary bean choices in a future catalog batch.

scope: named green, brown and black lentil varieties
decisions.rationale: Retain the approved generic dried/canned choices and optional dried red lentils. Other varieties/forms need specific evidence and separately reviewed directional compatibility; family text or aliases cannot supply it.
decisions.revisit: When a future batch has precise form/variety evidence and reviewed optional-choice navigation.

decisions.rationale: Retain the three approved dry rice choices. Basmati, jasmine and grain-length-unspecified brown rice already have explicit approved curated definitions; generic long-grain records must not silently supply named-variety identity. New cooking forms remain separate.
decisions.revisit: During the next rice/form review with suitable evidence and compact discovery.

decisions.rationale: Retain the approved flour choices and optional rice-flour variants. The proposed corn masa flour alias makes an existing identity discoverable, not a new food. Additional flours require specific cooking-form evidence and a broad-query/grouping review.
decisions.revisit: Before another flour batch; keep the default flour results within the reviewed discovery limit.

scope: additional fresh/frozen/canned vegetable and herb forms
additional tofu textures and yogurt fat/preparation types
decisions.rationale: This release does not claim every culinary form is complete. Retain the exact approved distinctions, including separate coriander/cardamom forms and fresh cilantro. New preservation, species, processing or texture choices require separate identity/coverage approval; custom entries remain private exact choices.
decisions.revisit: When a separately scoped future category batch supplies exact forms and culinary granularity.
